Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Moutaz usually hope their child will grow to embody harvested, withheld, delayed and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Moutaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “harvested, withheld, delayed.”
